name: Courtney Parella Spencer
current_role: Acting Assistant Secretary for Public Affairs, U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (since May 2026)
summary: Courtney Parella Spencer leads public affairs at the Department of Health and Human Services, where Robert F. Kennedy Jr. made her his top spokesperson in May 2026 after Rich Danker resigned in protest over the administration’s approval of fruit-flavored vapes. A former Trump 2020 campaign press secretary, she was previously deputy assistant secretary for public affairs and the main press contact at the Labor Department from March 2025.
